title: India Men's Team Beats Japan 3-0, Assured Asian Games Medal
indian_angle: India's men's team secured a medal at the Asian Games by defeating Japan 3-0, with strong performances from Lakshya Sen, Satwik-Chirag, and Ayush Shetty.
summary: Lakshya Sen won the first singles, followed by Satwik Sairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty's doubles victory, and Ayush Shetty clinched the second singles, leading India to a dominant 3-0 win over Japan in the Asian Games quarterfinals.

title: Asian Games Badminton: Men Assured Medal, Women's Team Out
indian_angle: India's men's team secured a historic back-to-back medal at the Asian Games, while the women's team's campaign ended in the quarterfinals.
summary: The Indian men's badminton team advanced to the semifinals, guaranteeing a medal and marking their first back-to-back medals in 40 years, while the women's team's run concluded with a quarterfinal exit after losing to Japan.

title: Sindhu-Led Women's Team Exits Asian Games Quarterfinals
indian_angle: The Indian women's badminton team, led by PV Sindhu, was eliminated from the Asian Games after a quarterfinal loss to Japan.
summary: Despite Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand winning their tie against world No.3 Yuki Fukushima and Mayu Matsumoto, the Sindhu-led Indian women's team lost 1-3 to Japan in the Asian Games quarterfinals.
